    # yields the compact output, excluding terminal separator lines where present.

    # All strong horizontal and vertical lines are the output sampling coordinates.
    # Remove the last separator if it has fewer than two marker intersections.
    out=[[grid[r][c] for c in vc] for r in hr]

    cols=[c for c in range(len(grid[0])) if sum(grid[r][c]!=bg for r in range(len(grid)))>1]
    return [[grid[r][c] for c in (cols[0],cols[-1])] for r in (rows[0],rows[-1])]
